summary: Outlines needs and requirements for a protocol to control distributed speech processing, including automatic speech recognition, speaker identification and verification, and text-to-speech. Existing protocols like SIP and RTSP handle rendezvous and control of media streams but do not cover these special needs. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Computers that listen to and speak with people need a remote control. This memo lists what that remote control must be able to do.
